slides.title: Component assignment and Undo
slides.code:
with unreal.ScopedEditorTransaction("Assign material"):
    component.modify()
    component.set_material(slot, instance)
    actual = component.get_material(slot)
    if actual != instance:
        raise RuntimeError("Assignment verification failed")
slides.explain:
Validated component, slot and instance

One component override changes.

Undo restores the assignment.
The new instance asset remains.
slides.question: Which change does this transaction cover?
slides.notes: This excerpt begins after validation and instance creation. Modify records the component for the editor transaction. Set material changes this component’s slot, and get material reads it back. An exception is not a promise of automatic rollback. The full tool restores assignments on failure and reports the draft asset separately. In our recorded rehearsal, Undo restored the assignment and retained the newly created instance.

slides.notes: Stewart’s Cinematic Builder example contrasts an artist-facing VFX duration with underlying spawn and kill keyframes. For our importer, a meaningful revised-prop result may be more useful than a list of internal package operations.
